digest.component_or_area: identity signing infrastructure for ticket-event writers
propositions: All ticket-event-writing environments (local dev, AWS auto-lander, GHA reconciler, GHA canary) must produce cryptographically signed events attributable to the correct identity when signing infrastructure is exercised.

A Rebar Bot identity ticket with registered ed25519 public key must exist, with its private key stored securely per environment (SSM for AWS, Actions secret for GitHub) and never committed to version control.

Ticket-event writers must resolve the current identity via .rebar/current_identity or git config user.email match and sign events only when both identity resolution and signing_key configuration succeed; session_log, code_review, and identity event types are gate-exempt.
The schema default for identity.require_authenticated must remain False; the flag must NOT be set to true in rebar.toml as part of this setup-only story.

All seven child tasks (bootstrap identity, conftest guard, local-dev docs, verify-identity CI, review-bot signing, canary key injection, reconciler inline-sign) must be completed and closed before this story closes.
